entities.name: Carlos Duarte Costa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlos Duarte Costa was a Brazilian bishop who became the founder of the Brazilian Catholic Apostolic Church, an Independent Catholic church, and its international communion, which long after his death became the short-lived Worldwide Communion of Catholic Apostolic Churches.
